Size_Data_Source: Cross-program (PISCO size-frequency pool, no 25 mm filter; KFM-internal size files not currently ingested)
Assumption: Cross-program: assumes the PISCO size-frequency pool is representative of urchins counted by KFM at the same MPA/year. Reasonable because PISCO and KFM sample many overlapping or near-by sites in the Channel Islands, but a known cross-program assumption.

Size_Data_Source: Cross-program (PISCO size-frequency pool, no 25 mm filter; LTER does not collect urchin sizes)
Assumption: Cross-program: assumes the PISCO size-frequency pool is representative of urchins at LTER sites in the same MPA/year.
